description: 夾層區住戶（resident）的建置配方：build_character.py 依這份檔案從頭產出角色。每個步驟的輸入輸出見 design/03-art-pipeline/CHARACTER_PIPELINE.md。
name: 夾層區住戶

design.prompt: Anime cel-shaded character art in the style of Studio Trigger's Cyberpunk Edgerunners: flat colors, bold clean black outlines, hard-edged two-tone shading, saturated neon accents. Full body, strict side view facing right, standing upright with the arms relaxed at the sides and empty hands, the far-side leg hidden behind the near leg. a tired anxious mezzanine-district resident, thin, about seven heads tall: messy hair, a faded blue home sweater and loose trousers, slippers, hunched worried posture. Empty hands.
